t: Spoolin' Up With the DeBertis: Beast Heading East
d: The guys take on one last challenge before making the move to North Carolina, building a truck that can haul their other trucks cross-country  they enlist the help of professionals to teach Brad how to properly drift his car.

With the deadline looming on his Alfa 158 build, Ant has yet to even start the engine, let alone give the car a test drive  Ant needs to finalize the look of his creation, so he seeks out legendary designer Chip Foose.

Ant has to strip the Alfa 158 down, paint every part and rebuild the car in time for its debut at the U.S. Grand Prix, then he puts the car through its paces on the track to see if performance lives up to expectations.

t: Downey's Dream Cars: Long Strange Trip
d: Setting his eyes on a used car that he has always wanted, Robert decides to flex his negotiating skills to achieve his goal.

t: Bad Chad Customs: Loud and Nasty
d: An old-time motorhead tasks Chad with building an open-wheel race car  on a budget, Chad decides to start with an antique engine and build the car around it, but getting the engine running is a tricky task that may require a miracle to achieve.
Lou and Jared work their magic on both old and new Challengers.
Chuck Liddell brings in a Ford Lightning to get proven tough.
Bogi finds an M-3 BMW she wants to buy for herself  the AGG Team will need to rebuild the brakes, bleed the clutch, install a new radiator and rework the front-end with new headlights.
The girls team up with IndyCar driver Ryan Hunter-Reay to design and build a new F150 that will be auctioned off to benefit the Cancer Research Foundation.
The three-wheeled episode of "All Girls Garage"  a Polaris Slingshot and a Vanderhall to play with  both vehicles have car engines but are registered as motorcycles because of the three wheels.
